title: Las Vegas Walking Photo Tour
includes: I am happy to take photos for you on my NEW iPhone 15 Pro equipped with wide angle lens. I will also edit up to three of your favorite photos for you using Lightroom and Photoshop.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
I am offering the perfect Las Vegas Strip experience for solo travelers, couples and groups, and families (as well as influencers and content creators) who want the perfect Vegas photos! 

I will make sure that you get the best photos to show off your trip to Las Vegas. We will visit the Bellagio, the Eiffel Tower replica at the Paris Hotel, the Flamingo Habitat inside the Flamingo Hotel, the Trevi Fountain replica outside of Caesars Palace, and the gondolas at the Venetian Hotel - taking photos and learning more about each spot! 

I will also share local insider tips and recommendations for restaurants, shows, activities, and off-Strip hidden gems.

You will leave this tour with social media worthy photos from all locations as well as new knowledge of the hotels and spots we visit.
